notes: Translated 1_dataprep.do and 2_analysis.do. Station-visit data merged by station name (equivalent to the scripts' per-file encode ids, since all files share the same 26 names); passersby merged by station-month-year; service/shuttle = walk <= 10 min; friendliness = station mean of each passerby's friendliest response (all-zero responses missing). Table 2: feols with date fixed effects (fixef.rm='none'), SEs clustered by station; subsample = alphabetical ids 9,10,14,17,18 (Farragut North, Farragut West, Gallery Place, McPherson Square, Metro Center).
